title: Rashtra Kavach Om
desc: A classified mission leaves a para commando with amnesia, unanswered questions and the duty of protecting his nation from terrorists. Along the way, he must find his father and prove his innocence.

title: Om Bheem Bush
desc: Three scientists arrive at a village in search of a treasure. However, things take a turn when they explore a haunted palace and discover black magic.

title: A Flying Jatt
desc: Aman who is scared of heights, discovers his superpowers when he is forced to face the evil Raka, who is sent by an industrialist to destroy humanity.

title: Fukrey
desc: Hunny, Choocha, Lali and Zafar want to make easy money and approach the notorious Bholi to invest in their plan. But when they lose her money, they must come up with a plan or face the consequences.

title: Gangaajal
desc: IPS Amit Kumar, an honest police officer, is tasked with curbing Tezpur's rampant crime rates. Here he must work with his fellow corrupt officers and deal with the town's insidious political figures.
